title: code_index.change_signature request
description: Change a function's parameter list and rewrite every call site across the workspace in one all-or-nothing edit. `params` is the complete new list in order: an entry whose `name` (or `from`) matches a current parameter keeps that parameter, an entry that matches none adds a parameter, and a current parameter no entry keeps is removed. The receiver (`self`, `cls`) is implicit and never listed. Call sites keep their argument text: positional arguments are remapped by position, Python keyword arguments by name, and a new parameter's `call_value` is written at every call. The function body is not rewritten except to rename the uses of a renamed parameter; adapting it to the new parameters is the caller's follow-up.

symbol_ref.description: The function to change. `name` and `path` (the defining file) are required; `line` (1-based) picks one declaration when several share the name; `kind` defaults to `Function`.

params.description: The complete new parameter list, in order, excluding the receiver.

name.description: The parameter's name after the change.

from.description: The current parameter this entry keeps under a new `name`. Omit it when the name is unchanged or the parameter is new.

type.description: Type annotation. Required for a new Rust parameter; replaces the current annotation of a kept one.

default.description: Default value expression (Python, TypeScript). A new parameter with only a default is not written at call sites.

call_value.description: Expression written for a new parameter at every existing call site.

dry_run.description: When true, plan and validate every edit and return `result: "dry_run"` without writing. Defaults to false.

session_id.description: Optional staged-fs session id. Reads and writes route through the session's overlay.
